channel.title: MiniNotes Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Nested lists, Obsidian-style: press Tab anywhere on a bullet, numbered, or task list line to indent it one level; Shift-Tab outdents. Selections indent every list line they touch.
  • Vertical indent guides mark each nesting level, drawn exactly under the parent item's bullet or number.
  • Nested numbered lists renumber automatically and independently per level — indenting an item restarts its count, and the outer list closes the gap.
  • Bullets, numbers, and checkboxes at every nesting depth share the same fixed indent width, so mixed nested lists stay perfectly aligned.
  • Outside lists, Tab inserts a tab character and never moves focus out of the editor.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Formatting hotkeys: press ⌘B / ⌘I to toggle bold and italic. Smart toggling works with the cursor anywhere inside styled text, with or without the markers selected, and through nested styles like bold+italic.
  • Nested styles now render correctly: ***bold italic*** shows as bold and italic with all markers hidden (same fix for styles nested inside strikethrough).
  • Clicking the left or right edge of rendered styled text places the cursor before/after the markdown source and reveals it, Obsidian-style.
  • Dragging a selection across rendered styled text now includes the markdown markers, matching Obsidian.
  • Obsidian-style reveal delay: styled text reveals its source shortly after mouse selection settles, keeping the layout stable during clicks, double-clicks, and drags.
  • Double-click selects exactly the group under the cursor — text or markers — like plain text.
  • Fixed invisible text selection on styled text in Preview mode.
  • ⌘B/⌘I are now robust at the edges of styled text: with the cursor anywhere in a starred run (markers included), they toggle the whole construct, keep both sides balanced with at most 3 asterisks, and repair malformed runs first — rapid presses can no longer flood asterisks.

item.title: Version 0.3.3
item.description:
What's New

  • Redesigned menu bar icon: an outlined rounded-rect badge with a pen, matching the size and style of the system input method icon.
  • The icon inverts to a solid badge while the notes panel is open, just like the input method icon when engaged.
  • The icon is now drawn as resolution-independent vector art, so it stays crisp and intact at every display scaling.
